decision.explanation: All three answers are valid and complementary descriptions of Alonso de Briceño’s occupation based on the provided sources. Document D1S2 explicitly identifies him as 'the esteemed Bishop of Caracas,' while D2S2 and D2S15 describe him as a 'Roman Catholic prelate' and 'Catholic bishop.' These titles are consistent with the hierarchical structure of the Catholic Church and reflect both his specific diocesan role and broader ecclesiastical status. There is no contradiction between these terms, and they refer to the same individual across documents. All answers are supported directly by the original text.
